description: The shapes the emulator's picture can have (cheats/aspect_ratio.py). The option cheat_aspect_ratio picks one of these names, or off: the game's own frame, 400 x 240 (5:3), which is what a real 3DS always shows. anchors: which side of a wider picture each root group of the interface keeps to (interface/hud/anchors.py).

ratios.description: Each ratio: its name, its width and height, in the order the program lists them.

anchors.description: Where the interface goes on a wider picture (interface/hud/anchors.py). A root group goes to the side of the 400 wide frame it lies on. follow_nulls: root groups the game moves by writing their first nulls, not their translate, which go by where those nulls are in play. corners: root groups that keep to a corner or an edge of the picture in both directions, from where the game's 400 x 240 frame has them (the talk windows and the chat log); this wins over keep_centred. edge_margin: a box this close to both sides crosses the whole frame and stays. half_margin: a box may pass the middle by this much and still lie in its half. dead_zone: a box across the middle whose centre is this close to it stays. keep_centred: root groups that stay (patterns). sides: root groups whose side this says, because the code places them. keep_width: panes that cross the frame but are no backdrop (patterns). stretch_groups: root groups that are a ground made of several sprites, which grow together (patterns). sub_views: a sub-view (the forge's preview) follows the frame around it.
